text:
samir: Heads-up — planning a config change to the dedicated GPU pool autoscaler tonight at 02:00 UTC. Goal: more steady baseline for low-latency workloads. Changes: min_replicas 1 -> 2, scale_down_delay 300s -> 600s, burst_headroom +10%. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Primary: maya, backup: kevin. Smoke checklist below. Any objections?
maya: Ack, I can be primary. Linking runbook: https://go/runbooks/dedicated-pool-policy (will update with exact CLI steps)
kevin: Quick q — will this touch reserved capacity reservations? any billing spike we should warn finance about?
samir: Not touching reservation contracts. We'll briefly spin extra nodes from burst capacity which may show a blip in infra usage for ~10–15m. Cost estimate: +1–2% for that hour. Finance FYI: @kevin please pass to cost owners if needed.
anya: One note: we should pin the canary model routing for the first 15m to the smaller canary slice so quality regressions don't impact all traffic. I'll set routing flag before you flip autoscaler.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by samir for 02:00 UTC. ID: dbd-2798765432. Reminder: follow smoke checklist and post results.
oncall-aaron: I'll shadow metrics for first 30m — will keep pager open. If p95 latency > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% in 5m, escalate and rollback.
samir: Smoke checklist (copy/paste for quick run):
```
# check cluster health
redwood infra pools get --name dedicated-gpu --json | jq .status
# tail recent logs
redwood logs tail --pool dedicated-gpu --limit 200
# quick low-latency request
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-canary","input":"hello"}' | jq .latency
# endpoint health
curl -s https://api.internal.redwood/v1/_health | jq .dedicated_pool
# confirm new policy rolled
redwood infra policy get --pool dedicated-gpu | grep min_replicas
```
Rollback command if we see trouble:
```
# rollback to previous policy tag
redwood infra policy set --pool dedicated-gpu --file policy-v2.json --who "rollback by $USER"
# or quick revert tag
redwood infra policy set --pool dedicated-gpu --tag policy-v1
```
Abort criteria (first 15m): any 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > +100ms vs baseline OR sustained CPU > 90% on pool. If triggered, run rollback and ping #incidents.
maya: I'll run the steps and post timestamps. I'll also validate the canary routing with @anya before the autoscaler flip. :thumbsup:
kevin: LGTM. Can someone add a cost-center tag to the deploy metadata? use "dedicated-ops-2026-q1"
maya: Will add cost tag in metadata when issuing the policy set command.
anya: I'll bump the alert thresholds to match the new baseline (p95 -> 180ms for a short window) before the flip, then revert after 30m if stable.
oncall-aaron: Also please wire in the synthetic test for model-echo — I'll watch that specifically.
samir: Awesome. Plan: 01:50 UTC — final preflight checks, 02:00 UTC — apply policy, 02:00–02:15 — canary + smoke, 02:15–02:45 — gradual ramp to full slice, 02:45–03:00 — monitor and cleanup. If no major issues, close out in thread and update runbook.
maya: copying plan locally. I'll ping here at each milestone. Anyone want to be in the zoom standby? I'll start one 10m before.
kevin: I'll join zoom for the canary window.
samir: Thanks all — if no last-minute flags I'll proceed with scheduling the infra change. :rocket:
maya: 02:00 UTC — starting preflight in 10m, will post results. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: dbd-2798765432 @2798765480
